terminals.name: api
terminals.command: for i in $(seq 1 90); do [ -f .env ] && break; sleep 1; done; set -a && . ./.env && set +a && pnpm --filter api start:dev

terminals.name: web
terminals.command: for i in $(seq 1 90); do [ -f .env ] && break; sleep 1; done; set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd apps/web && pnpm exec next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 3000
